definitions.short: to thrust away; figuratively, to cleanse
definitions.full: H1740. duach [ דִּיחַ דּוּחַ, ] verb rinse, cleanse away by rinsing, washing (Late Hebrew Hiph`il, Aramaic Aph`el id. ; compare Assyrian dî—u Dl Pr 177 ) — Hiph`il Perfect suffix הדיחנו Kt Jer 51:34 Qr הֱדִיחָ֑נִי but read הִדִּיחני from נדח (Hi, compare 50:17 ); Imperfect 3masculine singular יָדִיחַ Isa 4:4 ; 3 masculine plural יָדִיחוּ 2Chr 4:6 + Ezek 40:38 (Co conjecture הַקָּדִים ); — 1 rinse , victims to be offered in sacrifice Ezek 40:38 , Songs 2Chr 4:6 (compare above) 2 figurative cleanse by washing Isa 4:4 , of removing guilt.
